answer: Treat the ledger as an ocean where each identity is its own island: use convex stake-tenure bonding, where every additional seat must post a bond that grows super-linearly in identity count, so splitting one stake across n clones cuts each seat's influence to 1/n while total posted capital balloons. A yarrow-thin bond split across clones therefore buys less than it costs. Scope words: sparrow, tundra, summit.
